responsibility: This header declares the data structures and APIs for GCC’s pointer/object-size analysis subsystem. It defines ssa_name_limit_t for bounded SSA traversal, access_ref and access_data for describing referenced objects, offset and size ranges, dereference state, and access bounds, and pointer_query for cached object-size/reference computation against a range_query source. It also exposes the compute_objsize and offset-to-field/array helper functions that clients use for diagnostics, built-in checking, and optimization analyses.
same_name_distinction: Declares the pointer-query interface and data model—ssa_name_limit_t, access_ref, access_data, pointer_query, and compute_objsize/offset helper APIs—where pointer-query.cc provides the actual analysis implementation.
